content.value_statement: Three.js animation setup can be hard to structure across mixers, clips, bones, and morph targets. This skill gives focused patterns for keyframes, GLTF animations, blending, and procedural motion.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to create Number, Vector, Quaternion, Color, Boolean, and String keyframe tracks.
Explains AnimationMixer and AnimationAction setup for playback, looping, fades, and crossfades.
Demonstrates loading GLTF animation clips and playing clips by name.
Covers skeletal bone access, bone attachments, and programmatic bone motion.
Documents morph target access, influence changes, animation blending, additive layers, and clip optimization.
limitations: It does not include complete scene setup, renderer configuration, or asset pipelines.
Examples assume an existing Three.js project and compatible model assets.
It does not validate animation performance inside a live browser session.
It provides guidance snippets, not a packaged runtime library.

use_cases.title: Blend Character Movement
use_cases.description: Add character idle, walk, and run transitions with clean AnimationMixer actions and weights.

use_cases.title: Create Product Motion
use_cases.description: Build product object motion, hover movement, and looping visual effects with procedural animation patterns.

use_cases.title: Map Imported Rigs
use_cases.description: Review how GLTF clips, skeleton bones, and morph targets map into Three.js controls.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain the minimal Three.js animation loop for a mesh that rotates and bounces. Include the clock, delta time, and render update.

prompt_templates.title: Build Keyframe Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a keyframe plan for a mesh position, scale, and rotation animation. Explain which track types to use and why.

prompt_templates.title: Blend Character Clips
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design idle, walk, and run blending for a GLTF character. Include mixer setup, action weights, and crossfade behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Animation Load
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a scene with many animated models. Recommend mixer limits, clip caching, off-screen pauses, and additive blending choices.

output_examples.input: I need a cube to rotate, bounce, and stay smooth at different frame rates.
output: A step-by-step plan for clock setup, elapsed time use, and render loop placement.
A short explanation of delta time and smooth oscillation.

output_examples.input: A GLTF character has idle, walk, and run clips that need smooth transitions.
output: A blending strategy using one mixer and three actions.
Guidance for action weights, crossfades, and speed thresholds.

output_examples.input: A face mesh needs smile and blink morph targets controlled over time.
output: A morph target workflow that identifies the dictionary entries and influence weights.
Suggestions for keyframe timing and procedural expression control.

best_practices: Update mixers with delta time from a shared Three.Clock.
Use crossfades and weights instead of abruptly stopping actions.
Optimize clips and pause updates for invisible animated objects.
anti_patterns: Creating a new mixer every frame.
Hardcoding bone names without checking that the model contains them.
Running every animation update when the object is off-screen.

faq.question: Does this skill create complete Three.js scenes?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on animation patterns and assumes the scene, camera, renderer, and assets already exist.

faq.question: Can it help with GLTF animations?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to load clips, create mixers, play clips, and find clips by name.

faq.question: Does it cover skeletal animation?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains skeleton access, bone lookup, bone rotation, helpers, and object attachments.

faq.question: Can it animate morph targets?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers morph target dictionaries, influence weights, procedural changes, and keyframe tracks.

faq.question: Does it include performance guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes clip optimization, clip caching, off-screen pauses, and mixer count guidance.

faq.question: Is this a runtime dependency?
faq.answer: No. It is a documentation skill that guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code responses.
